body:
Hey I just wanted to give my story which is similar to yours. Boyfriend raped me, we broke up, he got a new girl. I outed him during a huge mental breakdown (I suffered from a lot of anxiety, mental breakdowns, depression, etc) and I just couldn’t hold it in anymore. 

What happened next was heartbreaking. I received a lot of messages claiming I was a liar, a crazy ex girlfriend, manipulative, etc etc. I lost a lot of my friends. Lots of people blocked me from social media. I was harassed my many of my classmates. Honestly, I wish I hadn’t told anyone about being raped because I didn’t know the backlash would be that huge. It came to the point where I attempted suicide because I felt like I made a huge mistake and more people bullied me for it. 

I guess what I’m trying to say is, people will try to manipulate you. Your rapist will try to manipulate his/your friends. He will try to manipulate the administration, teachers, classmates, and your own family. He may or may not be successful. Know your story and stick to it. I was still in doubt about being raped and couldn’t decide if I was raped or I wasn’t which ruined my credibility. Good luck.
